userStories.title: Create New Project
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create a new project with a name and description so that I can start planning my work.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter project name and description
Project is saved in projects directory

userStories.title: Generate Roadmap
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate a roadmap for my project so that I can see the planned phases.
acceptanceCriteria: System generates ROADMAP.md with milestones and phases
Roadmap is displayed in the UI

userStories.title: Plan Phase Tasks
userStories.description: As a user, I want to plan tasks for a phase so that I know what needs to be done.
acceptanceCriteria: User can select a phase to plan
System generates XML task plan using Ollama

userStories.title: Execute Tasks
userStories.description: As a user, I want to execute planned tasks so that work gets done automatically.
